section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: 10 Table 8 presents the statistics of suicidal deaths by the means adopted for self-destruction. A majority of persons adopted drowning, hanging and poison as the means of destroying their lives. These three means were responsible for about 23·7%, 19·2% and 20·2% of the total suicidal deaths respectively. TABLE 8
